বাংলাদেশে উন্নয়ন প্রকল্পে মার্কিন বিনিয়োগের সুযোগ
items.description: এক বিজ্ঞপ্তিতে এই তথ্য জানানো হয়েছে। তাতে বলা হয়, বেসরকারি বিনিয়োগের মাধ্যমে বাংলাদেশের উন্নয়ন চাহিদা মেটাতে ভূমিকা রাখবে ডিএফসি। ইতিমধ্যে দক্ষিণ এশিয়ায় জ্বালানি, অবকাঠামো ও প্রযুক্তি খাতে বিনিয়োগ করেছে সংস্থাটি।

items.title: Bangladesh may be among world’s worst cases of bank fund flight
items.description: Bangladesh may be among the worst cases in the world of money moved out of the banking sector, according to the adviser to a central bank taskforce formed to recover laundered assets.

items.title: Natural disasters caused $13.6b in losses over 23 years
items.description: Bangladesh suffered an estimated $13.6 billion in economic losses from 134 major natural disasters between 2000 and 2023, with tropical cyclones and riverine floods accounting for most of the damage.

items.title: How startups can get up to Tk 50 lakh in govt grants
items.description: The government has introduced a new funding policy for technology startups, offering grants ranging from Tk 1 lakh to Tk 50 lakh to help entrepreneurs turn innovative ideas into marketable products and businesses.

items.title: Marubeni weighs investment in sugar mills
items.description: Japanese trading company Marubeni Protechs Corporation is exploring a major investment in Bangladesh’s sugar industry, including three modern sugar mills, a distillery and facilities to improve sugarcane production.
